definition: Gemma is a series of source-available large language models developed by Google DeepMind.
details: It is based on similar technologies as Gemini. The first version was released in February 2024, followed by Gemma 2 in June 2024, Gemma 3 in March 2025, and the open-weights Gemma 4 in April 2026. Variants of Gemma have also been developed, such as the vision-language model PaliGemma and the model MedGemma for medical consultation topics.
story: Think of a grammar teacher who never memorized a rule but can still tell you when a sentence sounds wrong. The machine learns language the way you did — by hearing so much of it that the patterns sink in. It figures out meaning by noticing which words like to travel together. The machine learns to read between the lines by reading an impossible number of lines. And that is Gemma (language model) — teaching a machine to read between the lines.
